Name: Em's Seasonal Fishpond
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A seasonal retexture of the fish pond to hide between grass and natural paths
Each season, the pond changes its grass, but the little frog stays, looking after your fish
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55894/55894-1795363854-327832356.png[/img]

Like the original fish pond, there are four decoration options: [color=#e69138]plain[/color], two [color=#e69138]fishrods[/color] and a [color=#e69138]seasonal[/color] option
To change the decoration, the pond needs to have at least one fish
Right-click on the pond to open the menu and click on the raster with a red square
The initial decoration is chosen randomly when you build the pond and can be changed any time

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55894/55894-1795364227-1196212831.png[/img]

The fish pond has limitations in size due to the water animation, meaning I can only do so much to change its layout
The left/bottom connects perfectly with the grass. The right/top has a small gap between the grass you place and the grass from the pond You can hide this by placing a path or leaving an open area on that side

Ponds can be placed together, but aren't able to connect. There will always be a small gap between them
By adding patches of grass and paths, you can still make it look like they belong together!

By default, the vanilla pond in winter is frozen over
If you rather have the water open, there is an open winter pond in the assets folder
Replace the sprite with ice called: vanilla_fishpond_winter and you're pond has melted!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55894/55894-1795598955-515129188.png[/img]

The fishpond is compatible with four map recolours
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] (vibrant)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] (earthy)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url] (starblue)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37798]Elle's Cuter Grass[/url] (elle)[/*]
[/list]The default is set to the vanilla grass. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the fish pond mod folder
Replace "vanilla" with the name of the map you have installed
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
